usage: tunnel record start [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [--session NAME]

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --base BASE     where the admin API answers (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json          print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  --session NAME  file the calls under this session, switching the run onto
                  it; without it they go into the session in hand
